# Heroicons

Subset of the original optimized 24px SVGs from Tailwind Labs, pinned to v2.2.0.

Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons/tree/v2.2.0/optimized/24

MIT license; retained in LICENSE. The Django icon partial uses the original outline paths. heart-map.svg uses the original solid heart with a fixed red fill for MapLibre rasterization. No runtime CDN or JavaScript package.
